title: Honey

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Honey is a food and ingredient produced by Beehives. It is required to make Mead base.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: • Beehives are typically found within Abandoned Houses, however, they can also be found around Swamps. When the player breaks a beehive, they receive a Queen bee, which can be used to craft beehives at their base to create a honey farm.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: • Its main use is for mead base recipes and an intermediate cooking ingredient.

Honey

Type: Food | Internal ID: Honey | Source: Beehive | Usage: Cooking, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 8 | Max Stamina: 35 | Duration: 15m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

Introduction. Honey is a food and ingredient produced by Beehives. It is required to make Mead base.

Availability. • Beehives are typically found within Abandoned Houses, however, they can also be found around Swamps. When the player breaks a beehive, they receive a Queen bee, which can be used to craft beehives at their base to create a honey farm.

Tips. • Its main use is for mead base recipes and an intermediate cooking ingredient.
